title: REPORT on public procurement
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘maintaining high social and environmental standards’
part_context: Calls, therefore, on the Commission to fully align the public procurement reform with its strategic objectives aimed at reducing bureaucracy and regulatory burdens, simplification, <del>maintaining high social and environmental standards</del>, guaranteeing ambitious local economic development, promoting access for SMEs and boosting the EU’s competitiveness and security, including by addressing harmful dependencies in respect of certain vital products and services; advises against measures that could compromise any of these principles;
